name: Apple Automation
description: Drive the iOS Simulator on a linked macOS host semantically — read accessibility labels/identifiers and tap, type and gesture BY IDENTIFIER instead of pixel coordinates. Replaces the VNC pixel-coordinate workaround for iOS bug repro. Reached through aw-remote-hosts; no fixed machine, every setting is per-call overridable.

skills.description: Drive the iOS Simulator on a linked macOS host semantically — list/boot a simulator, read its accessibility tree, and tap/type/swipe/gesture BY IDENTIFIER instead of pixel coordinates. Use for anything about the iOS Simulator, iOS bug repro, or piloting aw-mobile's iOS app.

remote_backend_url.description: aw-backend base URL that fronts aw-remote-hosts, e.g. https://api.aw.tekflox.com. Every call goes through {url}/api/workspaces/{remote_workspace}/remote-hosts/{remote_host_id}/... . Set all three of remote_backend_url/remote_workspace/remote_token or none — with any one missing the tools fail naming exactly what's absent rather than guessing a host.

remote_workspace.description: The CALLING workspace's own slug (e.g. 'aw') — NOT the slug the target host happens to be registered under. aw-backend resolves host ownership server-side, so a host linked to a different workspace of yours is still reached via this workspace's own slug. Using the host's slug here returns 401.

remote_token.description: Bearer token for aw-backend — this workspace's AW_WORKSPACE_HOST_TOKEN (from the aw-remote-host /link handshake). Routed to the zero-knowledge secret store via POST /api/apps/apple-automation/settings — never stored in plain config, because it can run arbitrary commands on a personal Mac.

remote_host_id.description: Id of the linked macOS host running Xcode/the Simulator, from 'aw-workspace-cli remote-hosts hosts'. Defaults to Frederico's Mac.Home. Every tool accepts a per-call remote_host_id override.

axe_version.description: Pinned AXe (github.com/cameroncooke/AXe) version this app installs and calls for accessibility/input tools. Deliberately pinned, not 'latest' — a private-API tool that silently upgrades under you is a debugging nightmare. Bump it (and the matching sha256 in axe_agent.py) deliberately, e.g. after an Xcode major bump.

axe_dir.description: Directory on the REMOTE host under which AXe is installed, version-keyed as <axe_dir>/axe-<axe_version>/. A leading ~ is expanded against the remote host's own home, not this workspace's.

default_udid.description: Optional simulator UDID to target when none is passed per-call. Leave empty to target whichever simulator is currently Booted — every tool accepts a per-call udid override.

screenshot_dir.description: Directory on THIS workspace's own filesystem where sim_screenshot (and sim_describe_ui's raw:true escape hatch) save files, relative to the workspace root.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-apple-automation' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan apple-automation/mcp.json.
